content.text:
Global AI market could hit $6 trillion annually by 2031 through unlocking value and innovation - Bain & Co's 7th Global Technology Report: Bain said funding AI compute demand would require $6 trillion in annual revenue by 2031; it estimated existing consumer and enterprise applications could account for $1.2–$1.8 trillion, leaving $4.2 trillion to new categories. Bain also said infrastructure was being built ahead of the demand curve. (time=2026-09-29T00:05:00-04:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Investors' P-doom scenario in AI: Lack of profits: Axios summarized analysis by two Stanford economists estimating a nearly $1 trillion gap between hyperscaler AI spending and AI revenue since 2024, and stating that revenue would need to triple or quadruple next year and each following year for a decade. The article also notes assumptions and a more optimistic Goldman Sachs view of eventual returns. (time=2026-09-30T11:20:07Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
